title: Upgrade compatibility matrix and canary SLA simulator
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Create a reproducible compatibility matrix and a lightweight canary SLA simulator that runs a candidate release against representative traffic profiles and eval suites. The simulator will combine functional compatibility checks, perf tail latency estimates, and a smoke validation of critical serving paths (KV cache warmup, batching behavior, async retry policies). Goal is to catch cross-version regressions and provide deterministic pass/fail signals before promoting to canary and LTS channels.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator runs headless with a single command and returns pass/fail + detailed metrics
Compatibility matrix produced for all supported model families and known quantization variants
Perf regression detector flags ≥3% median or ≥10% p99 regressions against baseline and generates PR-friendly report
Integration hooks with rollout controller: simulator can be triggered by CI and by manual preflight in Console
Documentation and runbook with signal interpretation and recommended rollback thresholds
tasks: Design traffic profiles for low-latency interactive, high-throughput batch, and long-context streaming
Implement synthetic trace runner that replays prefix patterns and KV cache scenarios
Add metric collection for latency histograms, CPU/GPU utilization, and token-level throttling
Implement regression detection rules and thresholds configurable per-release and per-channel
Wire simulator into CI pipeline and add a Console action to run preflight for a build
Author runbook and update LTS promotion checklist
